blocks.t: ADDENDUM TO CROSSBOW™ OR CHEYENNE™ MANUAL

The Chiller™ game is based on the same cabinet and electonics as the Crossbow” or Cheyenne” series. This addendum is intended to note the differences bet n Chiller™ and the previous models. The diagnostics tests and error cades in the software remain as they were in the previous models, as do the printed circuit board schematics.
